app.title: PATINS
menu.controlsHint: Mobile: left joystick (further = faster; at the edge = sprint) · on the right Pass, Shoot and Dribble · PC: WASD + Shift sprint, J pass, K/Space shoot, L dribble
settings.title: Settings
tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.copied: Copied! Paste it in the chat with Claude.
tuning.copyFallback: Copy this text and paste it in the chat:
tuning.resetAllConfirm: Sure? All values go back to factory settings.
tuning.staleNotice: Claude changed the factory values of settings you had modified. Yours were removed: {list}
settings.tuningModeHint: Shows the ⚙ button in game to adjust the game-feel numbers.
tuning.ball.heavyBoardRestitution: Heavy ball: bounce off the boards
tuning.ball.heavyBoardFriction: Heavy ball: friction with the boards
tuning.ball.heavyBoardJitter: Heavy ball: random deflection off the boards
tuning.ball.heavyFloorRestitution: Heavy ball: bounce on the floor
tuning.ball.heavyPostRestitution: Heavy ball: bounce off the posts and bar
tuning.dribble.lossRate: How easily the ball gets away
tuning.input.joystickCurve: Stick curve (1 linear, more = finer at low tilt)
tuning.skating.sprintBoostOvershoot: Sprint push: overshoot above top speed
tuning.skating.skidSlide: Skid stop: how much it slides
tuning.cut.redirect: Exit speed (% of the speed you had)
tuning.mates.autoReceive: With the stick released, go and meet the pass
tuning.mates.switchLatchAngle: After a switch: stick turn to take control
tuning.mates.returnDelay: Return: time on the ball (only without switch)
tuning.mates.quickReturn: Quick return if you keep running (give-and-go)
tuning.mates.quickReturnDelay: Quick return: time before he gives it back
tuning.mates.interceptRadius: Pass is his if it passes within
tuning.mates.interceptMaxTime: Pass is his if it arrives within
tuning.mates.interceptSpeed: Speed to go and meet the pass
tuning.mates.settleRadius: Receiver: distance at which he stops moving
tuning.mates.settleTime: Receiver: time before the ball at which he stops moving
tuning.mates.fetchRadius: Picks up a slow ball within
tuning.pass.groundArrivalSpeed: Ground: speed when it reaches the teammate
tuning.pass.groundShortTo: Short low pass: normal speed from (distance)
tuning.pass.errorOffBalance: Direction error: skidding or in a trencada
tuning.pass.attributeAdvantage: How much a perfect Passing attribute reduces the error
tuning.shot.minSpeed: Charged shot: speed at the start of the charge
tuning.shot.maxSpeed: Charged shot: speed at full power (strong shot)
tuning.shot.tapTime: Tap: longest press that counts as a quick shot
tuning.shot.chargeSpeedFactor: Player speed while charging (of the top speed)
tuning.shot.mediumAimRange: Medium: stick angle from one post to the other
tuning.shot.lightAimRange: Light: stick angle from one post to the other
tuning.shot.strongAimRange: Strong: stick angle from one post to the other
tuning.shot.aimMaxOff: Beyond this angle it is not aiming at the goal
tuning.shot.farPost: Stick released: towards the far post (part of the way)
tuning.shot.highHeight: High shot: height when crossing the goal line
tuning.shot.chipLandBeyond: Chip shot: lands this far behind the line
tuning.shot.errorBase: Direction error (quick shot and start of the charge)
tuning.shot.errorOffBalance: Extra error off balance (skid or trencada)
tuning.shot.errorTurn: Extra error per radian of turn from where he faces
tuning.shot.turnFree: Turn from where he faces with no extra error
tuning.shot.attributeAdvantage: How much a perfect shot accuracy (shotAccuracy) reduces the error
tuning.shot.powerGain: Shot power (shotPower): extra speed from 40 to 90
tuning.shot.reticleRange: The reticle shows within this distance of the goal
tuning.shot.redirectFree: First touch: redirection of the ball with no extra error
tuning.shot.errorRedirect: First touch: extra error per radian of redirection
tuning.shot.turnRange: Turn shot: furthest distance from the goal
tuning.shot.turnMinAngle: Turn shot: from this angle with the back to the goal
tuning.shot.turnTime: Turn shot: time of the turn
tuning.shot.ctxSprint: Sprint weight (0 = as in v0.1.25; 100 % = the whole sprint error at full sprint with the ball)
tuning.shot.ctxOffBalance: Extra weight of a skid / trencada (on its error)
tuning.shot.ctxAngle: Weight of a closed angle (extra error at the full angle)
tuning.shot.ctxDistance: Weight of the distance (extra error per metre)
tuning.shot.ctxAssist: Assist level: context error removed by Strong (Medium, half)
tuning.shot.sweetSpotStart: Sweet spot: charge from which the error grows
tuning.shot.sweetSpotError: Sweet spot: extra error at full charge
tuning.volley.good: Good timing: ± around the good moment
tuning.volley.badError: Bad timing: extra error at the edge of the window
tuning.volley.minHeight: Lowest ball height (below: normal first touch)
tuning.volley.easySpeed: Easy ball: speed up to which it adds no difficulty
tuning.volley.hardSpeed: Hard ball: speed that adds +1 difficulty
tuning.volley.lowTarget: Low volley: height at the goal line
tuning.volley.lookahead: How far ahead the ball is followed
tuning.receive.controlAdvantage: How much a perfect Control attribute helps
tuning.receive.heavyAt: Difficulty where a heavy touch starts
tuning.receive.maxRelSpeed: Faster than this, he can't touch it
tuning.receive.reboundLift: Rebound: how the ball pops up
tuning.receive.lockTime: After a rebound or miss, time he can't touch it
tuning.wall.arrivalSpeed: Speed at which it gets back to your stick
tuning.wall.lead: Anticipation (where you will be, 1 = if you keep going)
tuning.wall.sprintGain: Sprinting: how much he is expected to speed up
tuning.wall.standingAhead: Standing: how far ahead it comes back
tuning.wall.minCorrection: Minimum aim correction on a wall pass
tuning.wall.errorFactor: Wall pass error (fraction of a normal pass's)
tuning.wall.reach: Reception zone for the ball coming back
tuning.wall.showMarkers: Floor markers (where it hits and where you meet it)
tuning.assist.lightCone: Light: cone to pick a teammate
tuning.assist.mediumCone: Medium: cone to choose a teammate
tuning.assist.mediumArrivalBonus: Medium: faster low pass (extra arrival speed)
tuning.assist.strongCone: Strong: cone to pick a teammate
tuning.assist.targetRing: Ring under the teammate who will receive
tuning.assist.lightSpaceRespect: Pass into space (Light): how much of your forward aim is respected (0 = off)
tuning.assist.mediumSpaceRespect: Pass into space (Medium): how much of your forward aim is respected (0 = off)
tuning.assist.strongSpaceRespect: Pass into space (Strong): how much of your forward aim is respected (0 = off)
tuning.assist.spaceCone: Pass into space: forward range around a running teammate
tuning.assist.spaceMinTime: Pass into space: minimum seconds ahead of the teammate
tuning.assist.spaceMaxTime: Pass into space: maximum seconds ahead of the teammate
tuning.assist.spaceArrivalSpeed: Pass into space: top arrival speed of the low pass
tuning.assist.spaceLaunchMin: Pass into space: lowest launch speed of the low pass
tuning.assist.spaceChargedArrivalSpeed: Pass into space: arrival speed at full power
tuning.assist.spaceDeadzone: Pass into space: smallest aim ahead that counts
tuning.assist.spaceRamp: Pass into space: degrees until fully respected
tuning.assist.spaceMinSpeed: Pass into space: teammate's minimum speed (across the line of sight)
tuning.pass.driveLaunchAngle: Driven lofted: maximum launch angle (short passes)
tuning.pass.driveLandShort: Driven lofted: lands before the teammate
tuning.passArrow.startOffset: Starts this far from the player
tuning.mates.lostPassSwitch: Lost pass: control goes to the teammate nearest the ball
tuning.pass.driveNoTargetMaxDistance: Charged driven lofted to nobody: distance
tuning.mates.autoSwitch: Loose ball: control goes to the one nearest the ball
tuning.mates.switchMargin: Auto switch: must be nearer by
tuning.game.speed: Game speed (the whole game at once)
tuning.pass.driveAirHeight: Driven lofted: height it reaches the teammate at (0 = as v0.1.27)
tuning.pass.driveAirApex: Driven lofted: highest point of the arc
tuning.pass.driveAirFull: Driven lofted arrives in the air up to (distance)
tuning.pass.driveAirEnd: From this distance on, the old driven lofted (lands short)
tuning.slowMo.enabled: Slow motion while the ball comes
tuning.slowMo.lead: Starts before the ball reaches the stick
tuning.receive.highMaxHeight: High ball: highest it can be taken down with the stick
tuning.receive.highPenalty: High ball: difficulty of taking it down from the air
tuning.receive.highEasySpeed: High ball: up to this speed it is no harder
tuning.diag.last: Last: ball {h} m off the floor, {d} m from the receiver, timing {t}
tuning.volleyCue.startSize: Size when it opens (× the ball)
tuning.volleyCue.endSize: Size at the good moment (× the ball)
